data.product_description: Cambium is software, so this visual is conceptual collateral rather than a product screenshot or shippable physical kit. The steward kit translates typed world-state, founder gates, and replay receipts into tactile brand objects without claiming they exist.

shot_types.purpose: make abstract operating concepts tactile without fabricating a software interface

shot_list.background: warm tactile mineral surface with sparse botanical material
shot_list.feature_focus: lichen field ledger, bone provenance cards, and brass decision token with one copper notch
shot_list.generation_prompt: Photorealistic editorial tabletop still life of a hypothetical Cambium steward kit: unbranded lichen clothbound ledger, circular brass token with three grooves and one copper notch, bone-paper provenance cards with abstract marks, dark-green pencil; tactile daylight, no text, logos, screens, neon, or tech gadget styling.
shot_list.label: Illustrative concept collateral — not a physical product or live UI
